name: TheFuseShop
old_description: Glass fuses have a low breaking capacity. It's easy to see when they're blown: the glass will be discolored and the filament broken. Replace yours today!
about:
TheFuseShop operates from Ames, Iowa, as an online retailer specializing in fuses and circuit protection components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The business stocks and sells a broad inventory of glass, ceramic, and automotive fuses, along with fuse holders, blocks, reducers, and circuit breakers. Its catalog spans thousands of part numbers from major manufacturers including Bussmann, Littelfuse, Mersen, SIBA, Fuji, and Daito, as well as circuit breaker lines from Eaton, GE, Siemens, Square D, ABB, and others. The company claims to maintain the largest selection of Bussmann fuses among U.S.-based retailers.

Customers span automotive restoration, electronics repair, industrial maintenance, appliance service, and HVAC fields. Reviews cite purchases for a 1970s automotive clock, Fluke multimeter fuse replacement, spa equipment, and dryer repair, indicating a mix of hobbyist, technician, and professional buyers.

TheFuseShop differentiates itself with free standard shipping on all U.S. orders, a library of how-to guides and video tutorials covering fuse basics and troubleshooting, and a stated focus on breadth of stock for hard-to-find fuse types.
